title: Retail Commerce governed reference package end-to-end phase contract

phases.objective: Prove that the Retail Commerce reference package forms one internally consistent, executable, reuse-first specification journey and that its Production schema baseline collector remains SELECT-only, bounded, secret-free, and capable of using either direct database metadata bindings or the existing governed Production runtime readback tool without granting provider, migration, deployment, or Production mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Retail Commerce manifest, specification, contracts, tasks, acceptance matrices, Work Map integration contract, read-only Production schema baseline collector, and owner-bound evidence trigger
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives a deterministic pass only when the complete package is present, its JSON and YAML contracts parse, all current Work Maps and schema domains are resolved without a new authority kernel, both authoritative schema-baseline sources pass fixture-backed tests, authoritative runtime gap results remain collected evidence rather than transport failures, the trigger remains fail-closed and artifact-first, completion remains truthful, and no database mutation or external business effect is inferred.
steps: Load the Retail Commerce package and resolve its bounded feature identity independently from its numeric display label.
Validate the Work Map integration against the current registry, coverage matrix, reuse-first policy, and zero-unresolved-dimension requirement.

Validate the Spec Kit completion contract and confirm that implementation, migration, deployment, provider, WordPress, WooCommerce, Google Drive, payment, publication, and Production mutation effects remain unclaimed.
Validate the specification package structure, JSON and YAML contracts, required artifacts, planned later phases, and absence of implementation files inside the bounded spec directory.

Execute the Production schema baseline collector against an injected fake pool and prove that every direct database statement is parameterized SELECT-only, no row data or credential values are returned, and no migration, database, provider, deployment, or external-business-write action occurs.

Execute the same collector through an injected fake Production runtime transport and prove that only governed_migration_schema_readback is called at the canonical auth host, the expected migration checksums, statement counts, tables, columns, and indexes are bound, and neither the backend key nor capability-envelope identifier is returned.

Return a valid governed readback with readback_status=fail and bounded missing schema or ledger expectations, then prove the authoritative baseline remains collected with parity_status=gaps_detected while transport failure without a readback remains rejected.
Parse both real repository migrations and prove the runtime request derives non-empty bounded tables, columns, and indexes from their reviewed SQL contracts.

Validate the owner-bound Draft trigger and prove it prefers complete direct DB bindings, falls back to BACKEND_API_KEY when direct bindings are unavailable, fails closed only when both authoritative sources are unavailable, uploads bounded evidence before final failure, and preserves exact-main and non-executable-drift evidence.

Trace the Business Operating Profile, Brand commerce authority, capability, Blueprint, adapter, workflow, evidence, migration, observability, and support requirements through their tasks, contracts, and acceptance evidence.
Emit a governed implementation handoff while preserving pilot Brand, provider topology, sandbox, taxonomy ownership, and rollout choices as explicit future implementation inputs.
assertions: The package identity is platform.reference.retail_commerce_operations and does not replace the governed Hostinger Storage feature that also uses numeric display label 014.
Brand scope is mandatory for commerce and one authoritative writer remains required per bounded domain per Brand.
Free-text onboarding data, capability recommendations, and solution Blueprints remain evidence or proposals and never become execution authority.
All current Work Maps and schema domains have explicit decisions, with zero unresolved dimensions and no new Work Map candidate.

The package reuses the existing platform runtime, policy, resource, provider, workflow, evidence, migration, observability, repository, delivery, and support authorities rather than creating parallel kernels.
The specification package contains no runtime, migration, or execution scripts inside its bounded directory.

The direct Production schema source accepts no free-form SQL, executes only parameterized SELECT statements, reads schema and migration-ledger metadata only, hashes the database identity, and never returns credential values.

The governed runtime source is pinned to https://auth.mad4b.com and governed_migration_schema_readback, derives all expectations from reviewed repository migrations, executes no local SQL, and never returns BACKEND_API_KEY or raw capability-envelope identifiers.

A governed readback with readback_status=fail remains authoritative baseline evidence when its migration identity, checksum, statement count, safety flags, schema expectations, and ledger metadata are present; it produces gaps_detected rather than collection_failed.
An HTTP or tool failure without an authoritative readback remains fail-closed and cannot be misclassified as a collected baseline.
The trigger remains same-repository, owner-bound, Draft-only, one-file, exact-base bound, read-only permissioned, artifact-first, and unmergeable by lifecycle policy.

Both sources require sql_execution=true only when SELECT metadata statements execute and mutation_sql_execution=false, row_data_read=false, migration_apply=false, database_mutation=false, provider_call=false, external_write=false, and secrets_included=false.

The specification and baseline evidence do not claim migration Apply, database mutation, provider execution, WordPress or WooCommerce writes, Google Drive writes, deployment, Production promotion, external business send, or secret inclusion.

phases.objective: Implement the approved profile, Brand commerce, capability, Blueprint, adapter, catalog, order, inventory, payment, webhook, file, evidence, and reconciliation contracts behind disabled-by-default governed runtime boundaries.

Prove tenant and Brand isolation, stale-profile rejection, idempotency, provider fault handling, webhook replay protection, unknown-outcome reconciliation, rollback, drift detection, and no-secret evidence under synthetic runtime faults.

Validate an explicitly authorized non-production pilot Brand, activity profile, provider topology, WordPress or WooCommerce sandbox where selected, Google Drive binding where selected, and complete readback evidence without implicit defaults.

Verify an exact authorized Production candidate, applied migrations, runtime and provider parity, Brand-scoped commerce behavior, monitoring, backup, rollback, and post-deployment evidence under a separate release authorization.
